name: Rolling Death
disable: DC 22 Thievery check (trained) to set the trip wire to a different anchor point without changing the tension

items.name: Tumbling Boulder
items.text:
Trigger The trip wire is pulled or severed

---
Effect The boulder careens from its holding area to crush anything in its path. Anyone in area A3 path takes 2d12+4 bludgeoning damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save save).

text: A trip wire hidden in the dust of the midway point of the floor releases a large boulder to roll from the northwestern corridor toward A4, crushing anything it meets.
